“你们这群衣冠禽兽给朕看好了。”
“凭一人之力！爆杀他妈的整个世界！”

The widow Cheng Zhang sat on the cold gold bricks of the Jinluan Hall.
In her arms she held a child as light as a bundle of firewood.
It had been a long time since anyone had called her Cheng Zhang. Everyone had called her a miserable person, a deserter, a stinky beggar, someone who deserved to be soaked in a pig cage, a bitch, and someone who died of hunger. After her husband was trampled on by Zhang Shan's horse and his chest was crushed, no one had called her Cheng Zhang for a long time. Now she has a new name.
A title that she didn’t understand: ironclad evidence of Emperor Zhaoming’s immorality!
Mrs. Cheng Zhang was carried here by gentlemen with pictures of birds and animals on their clothes.
She was as light as two bundles of firewood, cold and hungry, and there was no life in her dry eyes that had experienced natural disasters and man-made disasters.
On the dragon chair at the highest point of the Jinluan Hall, the sixteen-year-old Zhaoming Emperor Zuoxu stood up slowly. He spoke with a sinister smile.
Only after raising her children to serve His Majesty the God-Emperor did Cheng Zhang finally understand what Tianyin meant.
"I'll keep an eye on you bunch of dressed-up beasts."
"With one person's power! Kill the whole fucking world!"
The protagonist is neither a turtle nor aggrieved, she is here to be the emperor and have fun, she is the most beautiful female character, she is a nomad, a traitor, a traitor, and an alien, she will not pursue anything real or literary to make everyone unhappy.
